svg.title: Git Merges Two Devices' Task Files
svg.desc: On a pull, Git hands the driver three stage files. The merge is built and validated entirely in memory; only a valid result replaces Git's copy, and a refusal leaves both sides fenced so nothing is silently discarded.

text.tspan: Git Merges Two Devices' Task Files
On a pull, Git hands the driver three stage files. The merge is built and validated entirely in memory; only a valid result replaces Git's copy, and a refusal leaves both sides fenced so nothing is
three temp stage files (4 to 7 args; wrong arity
Early dispatch with a nil surface context: no
Read and parse base, ours, theirs (UTF-8, schema
Align records by stable id; combine independent
fields; union tags; prefer progressed states
Ours-first ordering, then a DFS walk guaranteeing
Dump the merged record set to canonical text
CheckText over the dumped text (ids, parents,
DFS pre-order, vocabularies); only a passing
Invalid: os.WriteFile ours in place with both sides
Refusal path. The path stays UU, tasks check fails on the
marker lines, and neither side has been summarized or
Exit status; Git copies the ours stage back over
Merged cleanly, or a conflict to resolve through
